opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode's mysteries, character developments, and overall direction, describing it as compelling and worth continuing.
Some viewers praised the character-focused material and found the episode's dramatic and thematic moments effective.
The episode's visual presentation drew both interest and reservations: viewers liked some stylish moments, but several found the 3D monster work distracting or only passable.
Some commenters criticized apparent visual inconsistencies and questioned whether certain animation details were errors.
A few viewers felt the episode leaned heavily on familiar genre influences, while others enjoyed those references.
